CMAKE_MINIMUM_REQUIRED(VERSION 3.18 FATAL_ERROR)

# Ensure installs stay under ~/.visit unless caller overrides the prefix.
if(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX_INITIALIZED_TO_DEFAULT)
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX "$ENV{HOME}/.visit" CACHE PATH
        "Default install prefix for user-local VisIt plugins." FORCE)
endif()

SET(VISIT_PLUGIN_DIR "$ENV{HOME}/.visit/3.4.2/linux-x86_64/plugins" CACHE PATH
    "Directory where VisIt installs database plugins.")
set(VISIT_DATABASE_PLUGIN_DIR "${VISIT_PLUGIN_DIR}/databases")
SET(VISIT_PLUGIN_VS_INSTALL_FILE "/sw/andes/visit/3.4.2/linux-x86_64/include/PluginVsInstall.cmake"
    CACHE FILEPATH "Path to PluginVsInstall.cmake from the VisIt installation.")
SET(VISIT_LIBRARY_DEPENDENCIES_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/VisItLibraryDependencies.cmake"
    CACHE FILEPATH "Path to VisIt's library dependency list for this plugin.")
INCLUDE("${VISIT_PLUGIN_VS_INSTALL_FILE}")
INCLUDE("${VISIT_LIBRARY_DEPENDENCIES_FILE}")

PROJECT(amrex_database)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_SKIP_BUILD_RPATH ON)
set(CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH ON)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN")
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH OFF)

include(FetchContent)

option(AMREX_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_BOUNDARY_CACHE
       "Skip building/caching structured boundary metadata for ghost synthesis"
       OFF)
if(AMREX_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_BOUNDARY_CACHE)
    add_compile_definitions(AMREX_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_BOUNDARY_CACHE)
endif()

SET(COMMON_SOURCES
amrexPluginInfo.C
amrexCommonPluginInfo.C
)

function(configure_amrex_plugin target_name)
    if(NOT TARGET ${target_name})
        return()
    endif()
    target_include_directories(${target_name} PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        ${VISIT_DATABASE_INCLUDES})
endfunction()

SET(LIBI_SOURCES
amrexPluginInfo.C
)

SET(LIBM_SOURCES
amrexMDServerPluginInfo.C
${COMMON_SOURCES}
avtamrexFileFormat.C
)

SET(LIBE_SOURCES
amrexEnginePluginInfo.C
${COMMON_SOURCES}
avtamrexFileFormat.C
)

LINK_DIRECTORIES(${VISIT_LIBRARY_DIR})

# AMReX superbuild
set(AMREX_GIT_TAG "24.05" CACHE STRING "AMReX git tag to fetch")
set(AMReX_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_FORTRAN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_EB OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_LINEAR_SOLVERS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_PARTICLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_FFT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_SPACEDIM 3 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)

option(VISIT_USE_VENDORED_MPICH
    "Use VisIt-provided MPICH headers and MPI wrappers when building AMReX" ON)
if(NOT VISIT_USE_VENDORED_MPICH)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "OpenMPI builds are no longer supported; set VISIT_USE_VENDORED_MPICH=ON.")
endif()

# Force AMReX to use VisIt's MPI runtime and locally-provided MPICH headers.
set(MPICH_HEADERS_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Path to MPICH headers (mpi.h)")
set(_mpich_header_candidates
    "${MPICH_HEADERS_ROOT}"
    "${VISIT_ROOT_INCLUDE_DIR}/mpich/include"
    "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_deps/mpich-install/include"
)
set(MPICH_INCLUDE_DIR "")
foreach(_mpich_candidate IN LISTS _mpich_header_candidates)
    if(_mpich_candidate AND EXISTS "${_mpich_candidate}/mpi.h")
        set(MPICH_INCLUDE_DIR "${_mpich_candidate}")
        break()
    endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT MPICH_INCLUDE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "MPICH headers (mpi.h) not found. Set MPICH_HEADERS_ROOT or run "
        "example_data/fetch_mpich_headers.sh to populate "
        "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_deps/mpich-install/include.")
endif()
unset(_mpich_candidate)
unset(_mpich_header_candidates)

set(MPI_C_COMPILER "${VISIT_BINARY_DIR}/mpicc" CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE)
set(MPI_CXX_COMPILER "${VISIT_BINARY_DIR}/mpicxx" CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE)
set(MPIEXEC_EXECUTABLE "${VISIT_BINARY_DIR}/mpiexec" CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE)
set(MPI_ASSUME_NO_BUILTIN_MPI TRUE CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MPI_SKIP_COMPILER_WRAPPER TRUE CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MPI_SKIP_GUESSING TRUE CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MPI_C_WORKS TRUE CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MPI_CXX_WORKS TRUE CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MPI_C_VERSION "3.3.1" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_CXX_VERSION "3.3.1" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_C_COMPILER_INCLUDE_DIRS "${MPICH_INCLUDE_DIR}" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_CXX_COMPILER_INCLUDE_DIRS "${MPICH_INCLUDE_DIR}" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_C_ADDITIONAL_INCLUDE_DIRS "${MPICH_INCLUDE_DIR}" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_CXX_ADDITIONAL_INCLUDE_DIRS "${MPICH_INCLUDE_DIR}" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_C_INCLUDE_DIRS "${MPICH_INCLUDE_DIR}" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_CXX_INCLUDE_DIRS "${MPICH_INCLUDE_DIR}" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_C_LIB_NAMES "mpi;pmpi" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_CXX_LIB_NAMES "mpi;pmpi" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_LIBRARY_DIR "${VISIT_LIBRARY_DIR}" CACHE PATH
    "Path to MPI libraries (libmpi/libpmpi) for FindMPI.")
set(MPI_mpi_LIBRARY "${MPI_LIBRARY_DIR}/libmpi${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}"
    CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE)
set(MPI_pmpi_LIBRARY "${MPI_LIBRARY_DIR}/libpmpi${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}"
    CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE)
set(MPI_C_LIBRARIES
    "${MPI_LIBRARY_DIR}/libmpi${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX};${MPI_LIBRARY_DIR}/libpmpi${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}"
    CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(MPI_CXX_LIBRARIES
    "${MPI_LIBRARY_DIR}/libmpi${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX};${MPI_LIBRARY_DIR}/libpmpi${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}"
    CACHE STRING "" FORCE)

FetchContent_Declare(
    amrex
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/AMReX-Codes/amrex.git
    GIT_TAG ${AMREX_GIT_TAG}
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
if(NOT VISIT_USE_VENDORED_MPICH)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "OpenMPI builds are no longer supported; set VISIT_USE_VENDORED_MPICH=ON.")
endif()
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(amrex)

set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_BENCHMARKING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_GET_SYMBOLS_WITH_LIBDWARF OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_USE_EXTERNAL_LIBDWARF OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_USE_EXTERNAL_ZSTD OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_GET_SYMBOLS_WITH_ADDR2LINE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_GET_SYMBOLS_WITH_NOTHING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${amrex_database_SOURCE_DIR}/extern/cpptrace ${amrex_database_BINARY_DIR}/cpptrace)

ADD_LIBRARY(IamrexDatabase ${LIBI_SOURCES})
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(IamrexDatabase visitcommon AMReX::amrex cpptrace::cpptrace)
configure_amrex_plugin(IamrexDatabase)
SET(INSTALLTARGETS IamrexDatabase)

IF(NOT VISIT_ENGINE_ONLY AND NOT VISIT_DBIO_ONLY)
    ADD_LIBRARY(MamrexDatabase ${LIBM_SOURCES})
    TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(MamrexDatabase visitcommon avtdbatts avtdatabase_ser AMReX::amrex cpptrace::cpptrace)
    configure_amrex_plugin(MamrexDatabase)
    ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(MamrexDatabase MDSERVER)
    SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} MamrexDatabase)
ENDIF(NOT VISIT_ENGINE_ONLY AND NOT VISIT_DBIO_ONLY)

ADD_LIBRARY(EamrexDatabase_ser ${LIBE_SOURCES})
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(EamrexDatabase_ser visitcommon avtpipeline_ser avtdatabase_ser AMReX::amrex cpptrace::cpptrace)
configure_amrex_plugin(EamrexDatabase_ser)
ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(EamrexDatabase_ser ENGINE)
SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} EamrexDatabase_ser)

IF(VISIT_PARALLEL)
    ADD_PARALLEL_LIBRARY(EamrexDatabase_par ${LIBE_SOURCES})
    TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(EamrexDatabase_par visitcommon avtpipeline_par avtdatabase_par AMReX::amrex cpptrace::cpptrace)
    configure_amrex_plugin(EamrexDatabase_par)
    ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(EamrexDatabase_par ENGINE)
    SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} EamrexDatabase_par)
ENDIF(VISIT_PARALLEL)

VISIT_INSTALL_DATABASE_PLUGINS(${INSTALLTARGETS})
install(FILES $<TARGET_FILE:AMReX::amrex> DESTINATION "${VISIT_DATABASE_PLUGIN_DIR}")
add_custom_target(install_amrex_shared ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "${VISIT_DATABASE_PLUGIN_DIR}"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
        $<TARGET_FILE:AMReX::amrex>
        "${VISIT_DATABASE_PLUGIN_DIR}"
    DEPENDS AMReX::amrex)
